brief: APT29 (a.k.a. Cozy Bear, Midnight Blizzard) is a Russian state-sponsored intrusion set known for stealthy intrusions against government and think-tank targets. Recent campaigns rely on PowerShell-based execution and HTTPS application-layer protocols for command-and-control. Plan a minimal kill-chain emulation campaign covering execution and command-and-control phases that this group is documented to use.
notes: Synthetic golden case backed by tests/fixtures/attack_mini.json and a small synthetic CTI corpus that names APT29's documented techniques.
